title: Path length after a new query
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a path on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ specify values at some coordinates, and choose a coordinate it does not yet specify and a value in $\mathbb{F}_2$. After adding that coordinate and value to the path, the number of specified coordinates is the original number plus one.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate not already specified by the path
